warning: Curated context about the data sources. Not model evidence and never a source of numbers in results.

notes.text: Vehicle miles traveled comes from the FHWA Traffic Volume Trends series published on FRED as TRFVOLUSM227NFWA. It covers all US roads and all vehicles, not only households.
Gasoline price is the BLS average price series for unleaded regular gasoline, US city average, published on FRED as APU00007471A.
Electricity price is the BLS average price series for electricity per kWh, US city average, published on FRED as APU000072610.
Real income is BEA real disposable personal income in chained 2017 dollars, published on FRED as DSPIC96.
Unemployment is the BLS civilian unemployment rate, published on FRED as UNRATE.
Prices are deflated with the BLS CPI for all urban consumers, published on FRED as CPIAUCSL.
